name: HTTP client (URLSession)
description: A small typed HTTP client on URLSession: requests that name their response type, JSON coding, status checks, typed errors and a stub client for previews.
usage: Describe each endpoint as `APIRequest<Response>` (`.get("restaurants")`, `try .post("orders", body: newOrder)`). Call `try await client.send(request)` from a view model through `any APIClient`. Use `URLSessionAPIClient(baseURL:)` in the app and `StubAPIClient` in previews and tests. Errors are `APIError` with user-presentable descriptions; cancellation is rethrown unchanged.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify url-session-networking` on a Mac with Xcode.
